decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The development fails to comply with the terms of Schedule 2, Part 11, Class B, Clause B.1(b) of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) (England) Order 2015 and the Local Planning Authority since the site is located in a Conservation Area and the proposed works are considered to be 'relevant demolition. 

In addition to the above, the applicant has not provided with evidence that a site notice has been erected on site, as required by clause B.2(b)(ii) of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) (England) Order 2015. Details regarding method statement and restoration of the site were not provided as required by clause B.2(b)(i)(aa) of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) (England) Order 2015

As such, the proposal does not comply with the prior approval process and fail to full the requirements of clauses B.2(b)(ii) and B.2(b)(i)(aa) of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) (England) Order 2015.
